meta.title: Send Bulk Counter Offers to all vendors from Settings
gaps: Verify the received counter offer in a second vendor's own login/session, and therefore prove that every vendor received it.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the received counter offer in a second vendor's own login/session, and therefore prove that every vendor received it.

plan.title: Bulk Counter Offers to All Vendors

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event so the RFQ stage can be configured.
Provide the required event title.
Create an RFQ-only event, which is the subject of the bulk counter-offer flow.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add a product for the vendor quotes.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite two vendors so the bulk counter-offer action has several vendor quotes to target.
Publish the RFQ so vendors can submit quotes.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Submit a quote from the first vendor portal.
Confirm the first vendor's quote was accepted.
Submit a quote from a different vendor portal to satisfy the several-quotes setup.
Confirm the second vendor's quote was accepted.
Open the RFQ Settings action that starts the bulk counter-offer flow.

args.goal: on the open Send Bulk Counter Offer drawer, decide the counter offer for all vendor bids, enter the counter-offer values and any required remark, click Send, and stop when the screen proves the bulk counter offer was sent

steps.note: Complete the buyer-side bulk counter-offer form and send it.
Verify the buyer-side comparison grid marks a vendor bid as having a counter offer.
Open the available invited vendor's supplier-portal session to verify receipt.
Open the event overview in the vendor portal without starting a new bid.
Confirm the available vendor sees the received counter offer.
